result.title: Cập nhật thông báo deprecation
result.description: Cập nhật thông báo deprecation từ Flask 3.1 sang Flask 3.2.
result.before:
warnings.warn(
            "The '__version__' attribute is deprecated and will be removed in"
            " Flask 3.1. Use feature detection or"
            " 'importlib.metadata.version(\"flask\")' instead.",
            DeprecationWarning,
            stacklevel=2,
        )
        return importlib.metadata.version("flask")
result.after:
warnings.warn(
                "The '__version__' attribute is deprecated and will be removed in"
                " Flask 3.2. Use feature detection or"
                " 'importlib.metadata.version(\"flask\")' instead.",
                DeprecationWarning,
                stacklevel=2,
            )
            return importlib.metadata.version("flask")
